summary: Republic Power Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a registered direct offering of 15,000,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.00 per share, raising net proceeds of approximately $14.56 million. The offering was made under an effective Form F-1 registration statement, with funds held in escrow until conditions were met. Proceeds are earmarked for R&D, expansion, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine securities issuance, not a special-situation transaction such as a rights offering or restructuring, so no special-situation classification applies.
